backgrounds.prompt: Use case: smartwatch watch face art. Asset type: square full-bleed actor-free background only. Scene: a vivid late-afternoon bamboo grove in a bright woodblock print, with tall deep emerald and blue-green bamboo framing both sides and a bold vermilion-orange setting sun peeking through upper-left leaves. Sunlit ochre leaves and warm amber carved marks add lively contrast. No birds or animals; the moving crane will be a separate transparent sprite. Preserve a calm dark teal-green field through the center third for pale clock digits and complications, with no bright accents behind them. Palette should feel bright, bold, and richly colored while keeping this central area dark. Japanese woodblock/washi print, crisp carved ink outlines, visible carved grain and paper fibers, flat layered colors and slight imperfect registration. Round-watch crop from a square. No moon, night sky, text, letters, numbers, interface, border, or watermark.
